required: reference passes the pinned network-disabled verifier
semantic reviewer confirms the assigned primary capability is substantive
runtime, dependency, timeout, and output contracts pass
exact, normalized, and fuzzy separation from every training and evaluation surface passes
source lineage, teacher evidence, record ID, rendered prompt hash, tests, and verifier evidence are sealed

construction_isolation.classifier_visibility: training source stimulus and ontology only
construction_isolation.semantic_reviewer_visibility: candidate specification and assigned ontology labels only; no evaluation data or verifier outputs
construction_isolation.source_selection: training-source queues only; source stimulus must be unique within the new corpus
construction_isolation.teacher_visibility: training stimulus, assigned primary capability, assigned cross-cutting dimension, and language runtime contract only
construction_isolation.test_author_visibility: candidate specification only; no reference, known-bad implementation, evaluation data, or teacher context

forbidden: deriving training specifications from private development or decision tasks
using private task archetype names as teacher prompts or corpus labels
reusing the unchanged all-edge-cases teacher instruction
claiming semantic diversity from lexical tags or prompt uniqueness alone
training, evaluation, promotion, merge, quantization, or publication
any GCloud read, upload, mutation, or billing action
hard_stops: any qualification cell remains empty after its one bounded replacement
any evaluation artifact is read by classifier, teacher, reviewer, or candidate construction
capability conformance or executable admission fails
pilot target requires more than 1200 new drafts
global separation or lineage evidence is incomplete

ontology.assignment_rule: exactly one primary capability and exactly one scheduled cross-cutting dimension per cell; a candidate may specify at most one additional cross-cutting dimension when intrinsically required
ontology.forbidden_shortcut: generic malformed/boundary/order/mutation boilerplate cannot count as primary-capability conformance

primary_capabilities.associative_aggregation: group, join, index, count, or aggregate records through maps or equivalent associative collections
primary_capabilities.binary_and_bitwise: transform byte-oriented data, masks, flags, compact encodings, or checksums
primary_capabilities.callbacks_and_events: coordinate callback, listener, handler, or event-driven control flow with explicit completion semantics
primary_capabilities.graph_and_tree: traverse or transform explicit graph, tree, dependency, hierarchy, or path structures
primary_capabilities.numeric_reasoning: implement bounded numeric transformations, ranges, ratios, accumulation, or integer-safe arithmetic
primary_capabilities.ordering_and_selection: rank, sort, select, merge, or prioritize values with explicit deterministic tie behavior
primary_capabilities.parsing_and_encoding: parse, validate, normalize, encode, decode, or serialize a defined textual or structured format
primary_capabilities.sequence_algorithms: transform, scan, partition, window, segment, rotate, or combine ordered sequences
primary_capabilities.stateful_workflows: implement an isolated stateful component with explicit transitions, rollback, idempotency, or lifecycle rules
primary_capabilities.string_and_unicode: transform or analyze text with explicit character, normalization, whitespace, or Unicode semantics

pilot_corpus_target.construction_authority: the 240-draft non-GCloud qualification is authorized by standing project scope; expansion beyond qualification is conditional on a sealed passing qualification result

qualification.purpose: measure teacher conformance, executable yield, and matrix feasibility before authorizing full construction
